editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood staple that's earned loyal devotion through its accessible Mexican-seafood cooking and round-the-clock availability.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit them on National Margarita Day for their $6 classic margaritas—a rare steal in Chicago—or visit late night when the kitchen's doing their best work; skip the pricier fried snapper and stick with their fajitas, chilaquiles, or combination platters.
